answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 22888 Country: India Title: What is the sunnah of performing Aqeeqa for a new born. Is it to be performed with in 7 days of birth of the baby wich is Masnoon. Or it can also be done later then 7 days. Question: What is the sunnah of performing Aqeeqa for a new born. Is it to be performed with in 7 days of birth of the baby wich is Masnoon. Or it can also be done later then 7 days. Answer ID: 22888 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 924/924/M=1431) Aqiqah is sunnah and mustahab on the seventh day. If it could not be done on the seventh day, then on 14th day, and if not then on 21st day and if not then it can be done any time. However it is better to perform it on seventh day i.e. if born on Friday, it should be done on Thursday. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
